newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAS says to raise ex-Germany rates 10-20pct from A.
newsitem.headline: MAS says to raise ex-Germany rates 10-20pct from A.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System (MAS) said it will raise ex-Germany rates by up to 20 percent from April.
Peter Skaryd, MAS cargo sales executive Germany, said the airline was following general market trends and strong demand for Malaysia.
"We are going to increase 10-20 percent to Asian destinations, not in March but from April," he told Reuters.
Rates to India would be increased by more than this to reach new market levels following the high, double-figure percentage rises by Lufthansa Cargo AG, he added.
Skaryd noted that rates in other European countries increasingly had to be taken into account in fixing ex-Germany rates.
"We have to be very careful because if we increase Germany rates and other countries do not increase them, then there could be more cross-border selling," he forecast.
MAS has already announced ex-Paris rates rises of five percent from March 1. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
